backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining taxi pickup logging with user profiles, access control, customer data, pickups, and reporting utilities using ordered maps and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purposes of various frontend files including UI components, hooks, pages, and dialogs.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint defining root div and loading the Vite/React main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app handling identity initialization, profile loading, and gating the driver flow behind ActorInitializationGate.
frontend/src/components/AboutDialog.tsx: Modal dialog showing app information, copyright, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/ActorInitializat: Wrapper that blocks rendering until the backend actor is ready, showing loading or error states with retry options.
frontend/src/components/CustomerLookup.t: Combobox component for searching or selecting customers with live suggestions and new-customer fallback.
frontend/src/components/CycleBalanceDial: Shows canister cycle balance with refresh, loading, and error states, formatting cycles into readable units.
frontend/src/components/DailyReportDialo: Generates daily pickup reports by fetching, deduplicating, grouping, and summarizing pickup data for a date range.
frontend/src/components/DeleteAllRecords: Confirmation dialog that deletes all records using a mutation and displays status and errors.
frontend/src/components/DeleteDraftDataD: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecord: Provides UI to select, edit, or delete a pickup record, loading data by date and submitting changes via mutations.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog for editing driver profile details with validation and mutation-based saving.
frontend/src/components/ExportImportDial: Handles exporting deduplicated data to JSON and importing data with preview and validation logic.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Static footer displaying copyright text and link attribution.
frontend/src/components/GeneratePDFDialo: Dialog component that opens a new window and injects styled HTML to generate and print a specification PDF.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main header with navigation menu, theme toggle, user actions, and multiple dialog triggers.
frontend/src/components/PickupForm.tsx: Form for recording taxi pickups with customer lookup, auto‑populate logic, validation, and submission.
frontend/src/components/PickupList.tsx: Displays deduplicated, chronologically sorted pickups with totals by payment method.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Wrapper around useActor providing simple readiness and loading flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, pickups, and customer suggestions using the backend actor and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AccountSetupPage.tsx: Renders a profile setup form allowing users to create or update their driver info with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an admin dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an admin login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Displays a login screen using Internet Identity with theme toggle and styled UI components.
frontend/src/pages/LoginSelectionPage.ts: Empty placeholder file for a login selection page.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Main authenticated app showing pickup entry and daily pickup list based on selected date.
frontend/src/utils/owedDriver.ts: Exports a function that calculates the amount owed to a driver from payment totals using a defined formula.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, and plugins with OKLCH-based design tokens.
project_state.json: Holds project metadata, known issues with actor initialization and calculation errors, and a list of existing features tied to readiness, error handling, and owed‑driver calculation updates.
